# pve_node_network_apply (Action)

Apply all pending network changes on a node and reload its network configuration (PUT /nodes/{node}/network).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_node_network_apply" "example" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_node_network_apply.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `regenerate_frr` (Boolean) Whether FRR config generation should get skipped or not. (default: 0)
